Here is a Git hook that lints Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) files:

```bash
#!/bin/sh

files=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep ".ipynb$")

for f in $files
do
    jupyter nbconvert --stdin --stdout --to notebook --execute "$f" || exit 1
done

echo "All notebooks executed and passed!"
```

Save this as a pre-commit hook in your Git repo at .git/hooks/pre-commit.

What this hook does:

- Gets the list of staged .ipynb files using git diff --cached 
- Loops through each .ipynb file
- Uses jupyter nbconvert to execute the notebook and check for errors
- If any notebook fails to execute, the commit is aborted
- If all notebooks execute successfully, the commit proceeds

This helps ensure that all Jupyter Notebooks in the repo are executable and have no errors before a commit is made.

Some things to note:

- The hook will use the Python kernel you have set as the default
